customerStep.title: Who is this order for?
customerStep.subtitle: Choose explicitly. Entering a phone number never creates an account on its own.

internal.title: Internal order — no customer
internal.desc: The current Admin order flow: work for the team, no customer is linked.

existing.title: Existing customer account
existing.desc: Link the order to a verified customer account right away.

new_account.title: Create a new customer account
new_account.desc: The customer gets a one-time secure link to activate an account; the same order then appears in their account.

guest.title: One-time guest — no account
guest.desc: No user, no password, no OTP and no app needed. The team manages contact externally (e.g. WhatsApp).

fields.accountManagerHint: Owns the follow-up with the customer. This does not make the Admin the customer.
fields.searchPlaceholder: Account ID, exact email, phone or name
fields.searchHint: Only verified, active customer accounts are listed. Contact details are masked.
fields.phoneHint: Used only to send the activation link. It is not proof of identity.
fields.phoneMatchWarning: A verified customer account already uses this number. If it is the same person, choose “Existing customer account” instead.
fields.referenceNameHint: A first name or nickname for the order — not a login identity.
fields.consent: How the customer agreed to be contacted
fields.notePlaceholder: Only what the team needs to serve this order
fields.pricePendingHint: Leave empty to keep the order as “pricing pending”.
fields.priceSeparateHint: Separate from the freelancer budget set in the order details.

errors.mode: Choose who this order is for.
errors.phone: Enter a valid international phone number (e.g. +9627XXXXXXXX).
errors.phoneRequiredForChannel: A contact number is required for WhatsApp or phone contact.
errors.price: Enter a valid price (up to 2 decimals) and a currency.

review.guestNoAccount: Guest — no account will be created

created.title: Order created
created.guestBody: Guest order {{orderCode}} was saved. No account was created. Copy the message below and send it to the customer.
created.accountBody: Order {{orderCode}} was saved and is waiting for the customer to activate an account. Send the one-time link below — it is shown only now.
created.existingBody: Order {{orderCode}} is linked to the customer account and is visible to the customer.

templates.account: Hello, your order {{orderCode}} has been registered — service: {{service}} — due: {{dueAt}} — price: {{price}}. To activate your account and view the order: {{link}}. All details and attachments are saved; there is no need to place the order again.
templates.guest: Hello, your order {{orderCode}} has been registered — service: {{service}} — due: {{dueAt}} — price: {{price}}. Our team will follow up with you here on WhatsApp; you don't need to create an account or install the app. If a payment is needed you will receive a separate secure payment link, and we will send updates and the delivery here.
templates.conversion: Hello, as requested, here is a one-time secure link to create your account and attach order {{orderCode}} to it: {{link}}. The order, its files and its history stay the same.

panel.title: Customer — order {{orderCode}}
panel.loadFailed: Could not load the customer details.
panel.noCustomer: This is an internal order. No customer is linked.
panel.awaitingActivation: The customer has not activated an account yet.
panel.revealNote: Revealing the number is recorded in the audit log.
panel.conversionHint: Only when the customer explicitly asks for an account. The same order, payment, files and history are kept.
panel.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. Customer asked on WhatsApp on 23 Nov
panel.privacyNote: Freelancers never see the customer's contact details.

claim.title: Your OrderzHouse order
claim.invalid: This link is invalid, was already used, or has expired. Please ask our team for a new link.
claim.intro: Sign in or create a customer account to view this order. Your order, its details and attachments are already saved.
claim.claimCta: Add this order to my account
claim.signedInAs: You are signed in. The order will be added to this account.
claim.wrongRole: Please sign in with a customer account to receive this order.
claim.successTitle: The order is now in your account
claim.successBody: You can follow order {{orderCode}} from “My orders”.

managed.readOnlyNote: Our team manages this order for you. For any change, contact your account manager.

serviceStep.title: Choose the service
serviceStep.subtitle: The service defines the fields and the quantity unit for this order.
serviceStep.noServiceHint: Uses the current form without extra fields.
serviceStep.categoryLocked: The category is set by the selected service.

form.filesShared: Files are stored securely with the order attachments.

errors.below_min: The value is below the minimum.

errors.mismatch: The category does not match the service.

catalog.title: Service catalog
catalog.description: Manage services, quantity units and dynamic fields. Every change creates a new version and never alters past orders.
catalog.noDelete: Services are never deleted to protect past orders; deactivate instead.

editor.name: Service name
editor.localeHint: Arabic and English are required; other languages fall back to English when empty.
editor.versionNotice: A new version is created if names, quantity or fields change. Past orders keep their version.
editor.previewHint: This is how the form will look when creating an order.

commercial.title: Pricing & assignment — {{orderCode}}
commercial.notApplicable: This is an internal order without a customer; it keeps the current direct-assignment flow.

quote.heading: Quote
quote.reviseHint: The current version is kept and superseded — never edited.
quote.linkOnce: The link is shown only now; any previous link stops working.

payment.paid_inactive: Paid on an inactive version — needs review

assign.heading: Assignment
assign.wizardNote: For customer orders the freelancer receives an offer to accept or reject; work starts only after payment or an Admin authorization.

terms.heading: Agreed terms
terms.immutable: Accepted terms are never edited; changes go through a change request.
terms.changeHint: Increases apply immediately (audited); reductions need the freelancer's approval.

override.heading: Authorize work before payment
override.hint: Requires a dedicated permission. Does not change the payment status.

commercial.failed: The action could not be completed

customerQuote.heading: Your quote

customerQuote.taxNote: No tax is applied to this quote.

guestPay.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask our team for a new link.
guestPay.noAccount: No account needed. Payment is processed securely by Stripe.
guestPay.successPending: Thank you. We are confirming your payment; this can take a moment.
guestPay.confirmed: Payment confirmed. Our team will follow up on WhatsApp.
guestPay.cancelled: The payment was not completed. You can try again.

offers.title: Assignment offers
offers.description: Review requirements, pay and deadline, then accept or reject. Work starts only after payment or Admin authorization.
offers.waitingStart: Accepted — waiting for payment or Admin authorization before you start.
